datasets.name: Worldview-1 satellite imagery of Wenchuan, Sichuan Province
datasets.verbatim: The image was taken by Worldview-1 satellite, its spatial resolution is 0.5 m, includes three bands of red, green and blue.

methods.name: SG-BiTLSTM (Semantic Gate and Bi-Temporal Long-Short Term Memory network)
methods.summary: A deep neural network architecture for landslide and hazard-affected body recognition. It uses a U-Net as an encoder for semantic segmentation and a bi-temporal LSTM decoder with a semantic gate to describe spatial relationships between landslides and surrounding objects, trained with an integrated loss function.
methods.verbatim: Therefore, we proposed a novel image captioning network called semantic gate and a bi-temporal long-short term memory network (SG-BiTLSTM) to remedy the shortcomings.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code for the SG-BiTLSTM method lacks a repository or persistent link.
